body: Martinique is a French overseas department in the Caribbean, so it counts as France. Coverage is very limited, consisting of only three Generation 3 trekkers, making it more useful to memorize the specific locations rather than general metas.

Habitation Clément is a rum distillery covered by a trekker. Key scenes include a warehouse, an exterior view with hills, a rural dirt track with red soil, and the distillery's interior with H-beam steel structures.

The coastal southern trekker features a hilly path with other people in the north and houses with orange roofs. It continues on a flatter path with ocean views and ends at a car park with stalls in the south.

The Jardin de Balata trekker has a very tropical and humid feel. It is recognizable by its dark and damp atmosphere, trees with buttress roots, ferns, and bamboo. A man in a black shirt and grey cap sometimes appears with the trekker.
